subject: english
title: 七上早鸟卷 · 英语
source: 考查范围：七年级上册（Starter Units 1–3、Units 1–7），按期末考试题型编写（不含听力），难度略高，百分制
note: 51 题，不含听力，百分制，考到七年级上册

items.stem:
—______ is your cousin?
—She's twelve. She's in Grade 7, too.
items.exp: 答语是年龄，用 how old 提问。

items.stem: There ______ some milk and two eggs on the kitchen table.
items.exp: there be 就近原则：离 be 最近的 milk 是不可数名词，用 is。

items.stem: There is ______ "u" and ______ "f" in the word "useful".
items.exp: 看读音不看字母：u 读 /juː/，以辅音音素开头，用 a；f 读 /ef/，以元音音素开头，用 an。坑点：看到元音字母 u 就用 an。

items.stem:
—Whose schoolbag is this?
—It's ______. Her name is on it.
items.exp: “Lucy 的”用名词所有格 Lucy's。

items.stem: My sister was born ______ the morning of June 1st, so her birthday is on Children's Day.
items.exp: 具体某一天的上午用 on。坑点：in the morning 前面有具体日期修饰时要改用 on。

items.stem:
—Does your father ______ breakfast at home?
—No, he ______. He usually eats at work.
items.exp: 助动词 does 后面用动词原形 have；主语 he，否定回答用 doesn't。

items.stem: Eric is good ______ swimming, so he wants to join the swimming club.
items.exp: be good at 擅长。be good for 对……有益，be good with 和……相处得好。

items.stem:
—How much ______ the sports shoes?
—______ 85 yuan.
items.exp: shoes 是复数，用 are，回答用 They're。

items.stem: We have Chinese, maths and English ______ Monday. My favourite day is Monday ______ I like these subjects.
items.exp: 星期几前用 on；后一句说喜欢周一的原因，用 because。

items.stem:
—Would you like to come to my birthday party this Saturday?
—______
items.exp: 接受邀请常说 I'd love to.（不说 Yes, I would.）

sections.title: My Weekend at the Library
sections.passage:
Hi! I'm Kate. Every Saturday morning, I go to the Sunshine Library (11) my mother. The library is not far (12) our home, so we walk there.
It's a big library. There (13) more than 50,000 books in it. My mother likes reading (14) about history. I like storybooks. I often sit by the window and read for two (15).
The library also has a reading club for students. Members meet every Saturday afternoon. They talk about the books they read and (16) their ideas. I wanted to join it, but I was a little (17). I'm not good at talking in front of many people. My mother said, "Don't worry. Practice makes perfect. You can try (18) a few words first."
So last week I joined the club. The members are very friendly. Now I can talk about my favourite books (19) them. I think reading is fun, and (20) books with friends is even more fun!

items.exp: 和妈妈一起去：with my mother。
be far from 离……远。
more than 50,000 books 是复数，用 are。
在图书馆，妈妈喜欢读历史方面的书。
一个上午坐在窗边读书，读两个小时。
读书会成员交流读过的书，分享想法：share their ideas。
后文说不擅长在很多人面前说话，所以有点害羞。
try doing sth. 试着做某事。
和他们一起谈论：talk about sth. with sb.。
动名词短语 sharing books with friends 作主语。

groups.label: B
groups.title: Lucy Is Never Late Now
groups.passage:
Lucy is a Grade 7 student. Last term, she was often late for school. Her alarm clock rang at 6:30, but she always stayed in bed for another twenty minutes. Then she had to eat breakfast quickly and run to the bus stop.
This term, Lucy made a plan. She goes to bed at 9:30 every night and gets up at 6:15. She puts her school things in her bag the night before, so she doesn't need to look for them in the morning. She has breakfast with her parents at 6:40 and leaves home at 7:05. It takes her fifteen minutes to walk to school. She gets to school ten minutes before the first class starts.
"Now I'm never late, and I'm not tired in class," Lucy says. "A good plan really helps!"

items.stem: What was Lucy's problem last term?
options: She was often late for school.
items.exp: Last term, she was often late for school。

items.stem: What time does Lucy go to bed now?
items.exp: She goes to bed at 9:30 every night。

items.stem: What does Lucy do the night before school?
options: She puts her school things in her bag.
items.exp: She puts her school things in her bag the night before。

items.stem: What time does the first class start at Lucy's school?
items.exp: 7:05 出门，走 15 分钟，7:20 到校；到校比第一节课早 10 分钟，所以第一节课 7:30 开始。

items.stem: What can we learn from the passage?
options: A good plan helps us use time well.
Walking to school is better than taking a bus.
We should go to bed after 10:00.
items.exp: Lucy 做了计划后不再迟到，最后一句 A good plan really helps!

groups.label: C
groups.title: School Life in the UK
groups.passage:
Hi, I'm Emma from London. In the UK, students usually start school at about 8:50 and finish at about 3:30. We have a short break in the morning and an hour for lunch. Many students have lunch at school, but some bring their own lunch boxes.
Most schools ask students to wear school uniforms. My uniform is a white shirt, a blue jumper and a grey skirt.
Our school year has three terms. Between the terms, we have holidays. The summer holiday is the longest — about six weeks.
After school, there are many clubs. I'm in the drama club and the music club. My brother likes sports, so he plays football twice a week.
What is your school day like? Please write and tell me!

items.stem: What time do students in the UK usually finish school?
items.exp: finish at about 3:30。

items.stem: How long is the lunch break?
items.exp: an hour for lunch。

items.stem: What colour is Emma's skirt?
items.exp: a grey skirt。白色是衬衫，蓝色是毛衣。

items.stem: How many terms are there in a school year in the UK?
items.exp: Our school year has three terms。

items.stem: Why does Emma write this passage?
options: To introduce school life in the UK and make friends.
To ask for help with her homework.
To invite readers to her drama club.
items.exp: 全文介绍英国学校生活，结尾请读者写信介绍自己的学校，有交友的意思。

sections.title: How to Make Friends at a New School
sections.passage:
Starting at a new school can be hard. You don't know many people there. Here are some ways to make new friends.
Be friendly. (36) A smile tells people you are kind and easy to talk to.
Start a conversation. You can ask your classmates simple questions, like "What's your favourite subject?" (37)
Join a club. (38) If you like music, join the music club. If you like sports, join a sports team.
Be a good listener. When others are talking, look at them and listen carefully. (39)
Be yourself. You don't need to change yourself to make friends. (40) Good friends will like you just the way you are.
choices: Smile at people when you see them.
People like to talk about things they love.
In clubs, you can meet students with the same interests.
Don't stop them or play with your phone.
True friends like the real you.
Homework is very important at a new school.
You should stay at home on weekends.

items.exp: 后一句说微笑让人觉得你友善，空格处建议微笑。
问对方最喜欢的科目，因为人们喜欢谈论自己热爱的东西。
段落主题是加入社团，空格说明在社团能认识兴趣相同的同学。
认真倾听，就不要打断别人、玩手机。
做自己，真正的朋友喜欢真实的你，和后一句意思一致。

sections.title: A Letter to Mike
sections.passage:
Dear Mike,
How are you? I'm very happy (41) (tell) you about my new school life. My school is big and beautiful. There are thirty (42) (class) in it. In front of the teaching building, there is a big playground. I often play basketball there with my (43) (friend) after school.
I have seven classes every day. My favourite subject is history (44) ______ it's very interesting. Our history teacher, Mr. Li, (45) (tell) us many stories about the past. My best friend Wang Hao likes maths, but I think it's a bit (46) (difficulty) for me.
I'm in the art club because I'm good at (47) (draw). Every Friday afternoon, we draw pictures together. Next month is my (48) (thirteen) birthday. My parents plan (49) (have) a party for me. Can you come? Please write to me and tell me about (50) (you) school.
Yours,
Li Lei

items.exp: be happy to do sth. 很高兴做某事。
thirty 后用复数；class 以 s 结尾，加 -es。
和朋友们一起打篮球，用复数 friends。
后半句是喜欢历史的原因，用 because。
主语 Mr. Li 是第三人称单数，一般现在时动词加 -s。
a bit 修饰形容词，difficulty 是名词，要变成形容词 difficult。
be good at 后接动名词 drawing。
第十三个生日，用序数词 thirteenth。
plan to do sth. 计划做某事。
名词 school 前用形容词性物主代词 your。

sections.prompt:
升入初中已经一个学期了，你的初中生活一定很丰富。你校英语报以“My New Life in Grade 7”为题征文。请写一篇短文，内容包括：1. 简单介绍你的学校；2. 介绍一位你喜欢的老师或同学；3. 你最喜欢的科目或社团及原因；4. 你对初中生活的感受。要求：80 词左右，开头已给出，不计入总词数；文中不得出现真实姓名和校名。
My New Life in Grade 7
I have been a middle school student for a term. ______
points: 最喜欢的科目或社团及原因
语言准确，有感受，衔接自然，书写规范
sections.sample:
My New Life in Grade 7
I have been a middle school student for a term. My school is big and beautiful. There is a big library and a playground in it.
My favourite teacher is Ms. Wang, our English teacher. She is kind and funny. She often tells us stories in English, so we all like her class.
My favourite subject is science because I can do many experiments in the lab. I'm also in the music club. I can play the guitar now.
My life in Grade 7 is busy but happy. I learn a lot every day, and I have many new friends. I love my new school life.
sections.exp: 四个要点要写全。可用句型：There is/are...、My favourite... is... because...、She often...、I'm good at...。注意一般现在时第三人称单数和名词复数。
